subject.title: fix(doctor): recover sibling moltbot.json config dropped on upgrade (#54200) [AI-assisted]

question: Should OpenClaw accept bounded `openclaw doctor --fix` recovery for sibling `.openclaw/moltbot.json` after the filename was retired?
rationale: The patch is a well-scoped fix for a valid upgrade regression, but accepting it restores a retired config filename through doctor repair and may replace a skeletal canonical config with credential-bearing legacy content.

options.title: Land Scoped Doctor Recovery
options.body: Accept the compatibility exception because the recovery stays in doctor, keeps runtime config canonical, and includes backup, restore, chmod, no-clobber coverage, and terminal proof.

options.title: Require Fix Mode For Every Write
options.body: Ask for a small follow-up so missing-canonical sibling `moltbot.json` recovery warns in read-only doctor and copies only under `doctor --fix`.

options.title: Decline Retired Filename Recovery
options.body: Close this PR and document the manual migration path if maintainers want `moltbot.json` to remain fully retired.

recommendation.title: Land Scoped Doctor Recovery
recommendation.body: Accept the compatibility exception because the recovery stays in doctor, keeps runtime config canonical, and includes backup, restore, chmod, no-clobber coverage, and terminal proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The config-path retirement, doctor migration policy, and prior issue cleanup history make this the best available owner for the compatibility decision.
